baseline_reproduction.note: Matching an existing export is necessary but does not establish an executable, causal baseline. Do not optimize overlays on an invalid baseline.

future_methodology_not_executed.atr: Wilder 14, completed bars only; entry ATR fixed for activation and TP; trailing ATR from last completed bar
future_methodology_not_executed.fills: mark triggers, separate executable prices, adverse gap fill plus fees/slippage; partial or unfilled stop possible
future_methodology_not_executed.daily_ambiguity: evaluate both O-H-L-C and O-L-H-C admissible paths and retain worse terminal equity; report ambiguous-bar count and sensitivity
future_methodology_not_executed.reentry: only at next canonical daily signal evaluation; rotations always supersede old position overlay
future_methodology_not_executed.selection: expanding training >=3 years, validation 1 year, next 1 year out-of-sample; select on validation Calmar subject to >=90% baseline CAGR, ties fewer trades then lexical ID
future_methodology_not_executed.holdout: NOT_OPENED_FOR_OVERLAY_SELECTION; no claim that previously analyzed repository history is unseen; establish new prospective holdout after baseline repair
future_methodology_not_executed.winner: holdout lower drawdown or ES95, higher Calmar, CAGR >=90% baseline, consistent majority of WF folds, survives leave-one-asset and leave-one-trade-out
future_methodology_not_executed.costs: venue hourly funding on full actual notional, account maker/taker tier, conservative execution slippage, extra stressed scenario
future_methodology_not_executed.premature_large_winner: paired baseline episode in top decile of completed training episode returns; overlay closed early and earned less; threshold frozen before test

overlay_architecture.recovery: exchange positions/orders/fills authoritative; journal keyed by position generation and canonical signal ID; reconstruct remaining size and monotonic high-water/stop
overlay_architecture.failure: record degraded protection; canonical rotation continues independently
